openings.claim: A sample-to-tag lookup interface could give the two assemblers pattern-specific picking guidance: each displayed sample component is paired on an existing tally sheet with its tray-tag colour, required quantity and specified dimensions. The bounded probe fits; delivering all participant kits successfully remains unproven.
openings.delta: Join the tags' material identification to the samples' pattern contents at each pick. Use pencil entries beside the displayed samples and mark an entry only after its contents enter the assigned envelope. Neither parent alone supplies this explicit type-to-pattern-quantity binding.
openings.prediction: Under matched pattern requirements, the linked interface reduces shared-material quantity omissions beyond separate cue improvements. The ultimate target remains all 60 complete, correctly assigned kits within 90 minutes, with at most one correction at distribution.
openings.rival_prediction: Forced sample consultation, rather than the binding, explains any improvement: equally frequent consultation of unlinked tags and samples produces the same omission rate as the hybrid.
openings.defeat: Matched batches show the linked interface no better than equally consulted unlinked parents, or its improvement does not exceed the separate parents' combined improvement. Excess handling time also defeats its usefulness for the 90-minute target.
openings.probe: Within one session capped at 90 minutes including checks, compare small matched batches using neither cue, tags alone, samples alone, linked cues, and equally consulted unlinked cues. Preserve assigned quantities and dimensions, use exactly two volunteers, existing supplies and the table footprint. Tally picking versus filling errors and elapsed time; an unfinished 60-kit session cannot establish success.
assumptions: Actual assigned patterns permit matched batches; O4's pattern mixture is unknown.
Existing tally-sheet space can carry legible mappings without enlarging the table footprint.
Sample contents accurately represent required quantities and dimensions.

component_comparison.baseline: Neither cue active: predicted most type/quantity ambiguity under identical specifications.
component_comparison.parent_a: Tags identify types; pattern quantities remain ambiguous.
component_comparison.parent_b: Samples show pattern contents; tray identification remains a separate lookup.
component_comparison.hybrid: Explicit bindings predict fewer shared-material quantity errors at comparable completion time.
component_comparison.interaction_test: Require error reduction beyond the sum of single-parent reductions versus baseline, plus superiority to equally consulted unlinked parents. All are predictions, not results.
